info.title: CF Meet Organizations Service internal API
info.description: Internal signed API of services/organizations (cfmeet.organizations), the first-party business organization authority (Blueprint v1.0 Sections 3-5, ADR 0056). Generated from and governed by docs/api/organizations-internal-v1.md. Every /internal/v1 route requires a packages/service-auth token whose issuer holds the stated permission in the receiver's trust bundle; replayed tokens are refused. The acting user (X-CF-Acting-User) is honoured only from callers holding organization.act-for-user. Never routed by public ingress.

post.summary: Create an organization (the acting user becomes OWNER)
post.description: Creates an ACTIVE organization (creationSource SELF_SERVICE, provisioningState PENDING) with the acting user as its first OWNER (joinedVia CREATOR). Per-actor creation limit: 5 per 24 hours (429 RATE_LIMITED), counted in the database. Writes an audit event and the organization.created / membership.activated outbox events in the same transaction.

cfServiceAuth.name: X-CF-Service-Authorization
cfServiceAuth.description: Bearer EdDSA service token from packages/service-auth (with X-CF-Request-Id and X-CF-Correlation-Id); audience cfmeet.organizations, runtime environment, expiry, single use and the receiver-granted permission are verified.

ActingUser.name: X-CF-Acting-User
ActingUser.description: The acting user authenticated by the account authority. Honoured only from callers holding organization.act-for-user; from any other caller the request is refused 403 ACTOR_NOT_ALLOWED.

ActingUserRequired.name: X-CF-Acting-User
ActingUserRequired.description: The acting user (required for this operation; 400 VALIDATION_ERROR when absent). Honoured only from callers holding organization.act-for-user.

ActingUserVerifiedEmail.name: X-CF-Acting-User-Verified-Email
ActingUserVerifiedEmail.description: The acting user's verified email (lower-case), for email-bound invitation acceptance. Same caller rule as X-CF-Acting-User.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Replay with the same body returns the stored response (24 h); a different body returns 409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT.

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: Keyset cursor (nextCursor of the previous page).

CreateOrganizationRequest.description: No user id, role or tenant is accepted from the body: the acting user is the signed X-CF-Acting-User.

Error.description: Error envelope (Cache-Control: no-store). Messages never contain a token, an email address or database text.

EvaluateResponse.description: A non-member (or unknown organization) gets NOT_A_MEMBER with null organizationStatus and role (non-enumerating).

ImportReport.description: imported / unchanged count rows (organizations + memberships); a differing row is reported in conflicts and never overwritten.

Invitation.description: An invitation; never the email address or the token.

token.description: The one-time invitation token (returned only here; only its SHA-256 is stored). An idempotent replay re-issues a fresh token for a still-pending invitation.

InvitationCreated.description: The created invitation and its one-time token.

LegalRegistration.description: Optional legal registration; SELF_DECLARED until an operator verifies it. createdAt of the organization is never an incorporation date.

LifecycleRequest.description: Optional body; an empty body is accepted.

MigrationExport.description: Meeting Service export (contract section 5). Checksum: SHA-256 (lower-case hex) over UTF-8 lines each followed by \n: org|{id}|{sha256hex(name)}|{slug}|{status}|{createdBy or -}|{createdAt unix microseconds} sorted by id, then mem|{id}|{organizationId}|{userId}|{role}|{status}|{createdAt unix microseconds} sorted by id. Test vector: one organization 00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001 'Acme Health' acme-health ACTIVE createdBy null createdAt 2026-10-04T12:00:00Z and one OWNER ACTIVE membership 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000000b1 of user 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000000a1 with the same createdAt give 1a212f81add323e1e9bed715699c0ba8c97b2dc22e211c84a05bca42d0908e78.

Organization.description: An organization. Imported legacy slugs keep the Meeting Service rule; new and changed slugs follow the contract pattern.

expectedVersion.description: The organization's version (bumped by the transfer).

ProfileInput.description: Profile fields. On PATCH an absent field is unchanged and null clears it; legalRegistration replaces the whole registration and is always SELF_DECLARED.

Reconciliation.description: Counts, the checksum of the imported rows in their current state (export algorithm), the last import and mismatches (CHECKSUM_MISMATCH, ORGANIZATION_COUNT_MISMATCH, MEMBERSHIP_COUNT_MISMATCH, IMPORT_CONFLICTS).

Viewer.description: The acting user's membership and effective capabilities (present only for actor reads).
